name: smwgraphics-fire-emblem-heroes-d-kk-lfheimr-realm-of-nightmares-forest
title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares (Forest)
description:
This is the forest background of Dökkálfheimr, the Realm of Nightmares, from Fire Emblem Heroes. You may use it with the foreground here if you wish. This background, combined with the tileset is perfect if you want to create a level that takes place in an alien environment.

Note: Due to Layer 3 being on Subscreen, I highly recommend you use a different status bar, such as the Minimalist Status Bar or the DKCR-styled one.

No credit is necessary, but it is appreciated!
